scripts.bootstrap: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && pnpm install && cargo fetch --locked && uv sync --locked --all-packages
scripts.gen:check: pnpm gen && bash scripts/check-clean.sh packages/proto/src/gen sdk/python/src/sfly/schemas
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:proto && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:py && pnpm lint:node
scripts.lint:py: uv run --locked ruff check && uv run --locked ruff format --check
scripts.format: biome check --write . && buf format -w && cargo fmt --all && uv run ruff format && uv run ruff check --fix
scripts.test: pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:py
scripts.test:bundle: SFLY_BUNDLE_DIR="$PWD/out/server" pnpm --filter @sfly/server exec vitest run test/bundle-smoke.test.ts
scripts.pack:agents: bash scripts/release/pack-agent.sh x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && bash scripts/release/pack-agent.sh aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
scripts.check: pnpm release:version check && pnpm gen:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm proto:breaking && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm pack:agents && pnpm bundle:server && pnpm test:bundle && pnpm test:image
